Get going in three steps

1

Create your workspace

Sign up with your email, set your currency, and invite your team. Your tenant is provisioned instantly.

2

Add products and stock

Use the bulk Excel import to load your catalog and set opening stock levels for each branch.

3

Start selling

Open the POS terminal, take cash, M-Pesa, or card payments, and watch your dashboard update live.
